title: Initial b Pronunciation Demo
notes: Close both lips
column7: then open quickly with a light unaspirated release. Do not pronounce it like p.

title: Initial p Pronunciation Demo
notes: Close both lips

title: Initial m Pronunciation Demo
notes: Close both lips and let air flow through the nose. Do not turn the onset into b or p.

title: Initial f Pronunciation Demo
notes: Touch the upper teeth lightly to the lower lip and release air through the lip-teeth gap.

title: Initial z Pronunciation Demo
notes: Place the tongue tip behind the upper teeth and release lightly without strong aspiration.

title: Initial c Pronunciation Demo
notes: Place the tongue tip behind the upper teeth and release with clear aspiration.

title: Initial s Pronunciation Demo
notes: Keep a narrow gap near the upper teeth so the airflow creates friction.

title: Initial d Pronunciation Demo
notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and release shortly without aspiration.

title: Initial t Pronunciation Demo
notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge and release with strong aspiration.

title: Initial n Pronunciation Demo
notes: Touch the tongue tip lightly to the upper gum ridge and let air flow through the nose.

title: Initial l Pronunciation Demo
notes: Touch the tongue tip to the upper gum ridge
column7: then let air pass along the sides of the tongue.

title: Initial zh Pronunciation Demo
notes: Curl the tongue tip slightly back toward the front hard palate and release without too much aspiration.

title: Initial ch Pronunciation Demo
notes: Keep the tongue tip curled back and release with clear aspiration.

title: Initial sh Pronunciation Demo
notes: Curl the tongue tip back and form a narrow gap for friction.

title: Initial r Pronunciation Demo
notes: Curl the tongue tip slightly back
column8: and keep the sound soft. Do not pronounce it like l.

title: Initial j Pronunciation Demo
notes: Bring the front of the tongue close to the hard palate and release without clear aspiration.

title: Initial q Pronunciation Demo
notes: Bring the front of the tongue close to the hard palate and release with clear aspiration.

title: Initial x Pronunciation Demo
notes: Bring the front of the tongue near the hard palate and let the airflow pass through a narrow gap.

title: Initial g Pronunciation Demo
notes: Raise the tongue root to the soft palate and release shortly without aspiration.

title: Initial k Pronunciation Demo
notes: Raise the tongue root to the soft palate and release with strong aspiration.

title: Initial h Pronunciation Demo
notes: Bring the tongue root near the soft palate and release a gentle friction sound from the back of the throat.

title: Final a Pronunciation Demo
notes: Open the mouth

title: Final o Pronunciation Demo
notes: Round both lips and keep a rounded mouth space.

title: Final e Pronunciation Demo
notes: Relax the mouth corners
column8: and hold a stable mouth space.

title: Final i Pronunciation Demo
notes: Spread the mouth corners

title: Final u Pronunciation Demo
notes: Round the lips forward

title: Final v Pronunciation Demo
notes: Keep the tongue position of i while rounding the lips. Avoid turning it into u.

title: Final i_z Pronunciation Demo
notes: Used in zi
column8: and si. Keep the tongue tip near the back of the upper teeth; do not pronounce it like regular i.

title: Final i_zh Pronunciation Demo
notes: Used in zhi
column9: and ri. Keep the retroflex position; do not pronounce it like regular i.

title: Final er Pronunciation Demo
notes: Curl the tongue tip lightly and keep the retroflex sound natural

title: Final ai Pronunciation Demo
notes: Glide from open a toward narrower i with a smooth mouth-shape change.

title: Final ia Pronunciation Demo
notes: Start from the high tongue position of i

title: Final ueng Pronunciation Demo
notes: Start with rounded u
column7: then transition into the back nasal eng.

title: Final uang Pronunciation Demo
notes: Start with rounded u
column8: and complete the back nasal ending.

title: Final iong Pronunciation Demo
notes: Keep the tongue body high with rounded lips
column7: then finish into the back nasal ong.
